title: Addressing the Proof review agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Proof review agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `proof-review-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Adversarial but specific
rules.description: Adversarial but specific. State the step that does not follow, or the hypothesis that makes the statement vacuous.

source.quote: Assumes a proof that compiles may still prove nothing. Knows the difference between a gap in the argument and a gap in the exposition, and that the second is not the lesser one.
